login.title: Sign in to the panel
login.description: Your panel password, not a device password.

setup.title: First run
setup.description: There are no users yet. Create an administrator — this needs the one-time setup code the server wrote to its log on startup.
setup.findCode: Find the code in the server log
setup.restartHint: The code changes when the server restarts — use the last line.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Your other sessions will be signed out; this one stays.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: KOReader devices that sync reading progress with this server. Each one has its own password.
devices.emptyText: Add a reader: the panel will issue a password and show what to enter in KOReader.
devices.reportedHint: How the device names itself in KOReader
devices.name: Name
devices.nameHint: Up to 64 characters. Shown only in the panel.

createDialog.title: New device
createDialog.description: The password is shown once, right after the device is created.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke “{{name}}”?
revokeDialog.description: The reader stops syncing immediately; its reading history is kept. A revoked device cannot be restored: to connect the reader again, create a new one.

resetDialog.title: New password for “{{name}}”?
resetDialog.description: The old password stops working immediately, and you will need to log in again in KOReader. The device name and history are kept.

passwordCard.title: Password for “{{name}}”
passwordCard.once: This password is shown only now. Enter it in KOReader or save it in a password manager.

koreader.title: What to enter in KOReader
koreader.step3: — enter the username and password, then tap
koreader.step4Hint: so the server knows book titles. The option is available in KOReader 2026.07 and later.
koreader.serverHint: The address this panel is open at. If the reader reaches the server at a different address, enter that one.

empty.title: The server is ready. The shelf is empty for now
empty.text: Books and progress will appear here after the first sync from a reader. No plugins needed — KOReader's built-in sync is enough.
empty.step1Text: The server issues a short password that is easy to type on a reader.
empty.step1Done: You already have a device. If its password is lost, issue a new one on the devices page.
empty.step2Password: and the device password from step 1.
empty.metadataText: Without it, books arrive without titles and authors, as unknown books. The option is available in KOReader 2026.07 and later.
empty.step3Title: Open a book and turn a few pages
empty.step3Text: Progress is sent when you close the book or run sync manually.

books.title: Books
books.description: Books that sent reading progress, most recently synced first.

empty.all: No books yet: they will appear after the first sync from a reader.
empty.unknown: No unknown books — every book has a title.

book.notFoundText: This book is not among yours: no progress was received for it.
book.unknownTitle: The title will appear once you turn on
book.unknownText: KOReader will send the title, authors and file name with the next sync. The option is available in KOReader 2026.07 and later.

errors.invalid_password: The password must be 8 to 256 characters long.
errors.invalid_username: The name must not be empty or contain “:”.
errors.setup_completed: Setup is already complete: sign in to the panel.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.cross_origin: Request rejected: it came from another site.
errors.not_found: Device not found: it may have been revoked already.
errors.user_not_found: User not found: it may have been deleted.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.device_exists: A device with this name already exists.
errors.invalid_device_name: The name must be 1 to 64 characters long.
errors.unknown: The request failed. Please try again.
